bio.text: Jasmeet Bains was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2022 to represent the 35th Assembly District in Kern County; her official biography says she is the first Sikh American elected to California state office.
She is a physician whose work includes family medicine and addiction care, and she completed her residency at Clinica Sierra Vista in Kern County.
The daughter of immigrant parents from India, she grew up in the Valley; in 2017 Gov. Jerry Brown appointed her to chair the California Healthcare Workforce Policy Commission.
